name: Voronoi Cells
desc: A living mosaic of drifting Voronoi cells that bounce, gather and scatter to the beat, rendered as leaded stained glass, crystalline shards, translucent biological membranes, a thermal false-color heat field, or a bare glowing edge network.

style.doc: aesthetic: leaded luminous glass / hard faceted crystal / translucent biological membranes / thermal false-color heat field / bare glowing edge network (abstract)

act.doc: multi-minute program: drift free-floats, swarm gathers and scatters each section, breathe slowly inhales and exhales the field

seed.doc: site positions, velocities and hue jitter
